profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: A software engineer with years of experience in system software & embedded firmware development, and HW bring-up and validation

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Working on Google Pixel Phone Bootloader Development
* Working on Google Pixel Phone HW Bring-up
* Worked on Google Cloud HW Bring-up & Validatoin
* C, C++, Assembly (ARM & x86)

positions.title: Senior Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
* Worked on custom ASIC development; CPU, GPU, Southbridge, etc. I have worked on pre & post tape-out ASIC simulation, emulation, and verification. After the tape-out, I have also worked on various ASCI and HW bring-ups.

* Worked on system software for Xbox & HoloLens. I have developed OS kernel device drivers and hardware validation & monitoring software for Xbox and HoloLens.

* Worked on embedded system development. I have developed firmware for various embedded systems using ARM, Zynq-7000, and Tensilica processors. More specifically, I worked on developing bootloaders, OS schedulers, I2C/SPI/UART bus drivers, memory manager, etc.

* Worked on graphics application development using DirectX 11 & 12. I have developed graphics applications using DirectX 11 and 12 that are designed to exercise & verify each GPU functional block, Command Processor, Compute Units, Memory Bus, etc.

* Worked on Xbox console manufacturing software. I have developed HW stress & validation software for Xbox console manufacturing. These software are designed to catch faulty HW parts and system boards before they are shipped out to customers.

positions.title: SW Engineer Staff
positions.description:
*	Led the development of consumer anti-spam software "SonicWALL AntiSpam Desktop" (formally "MailFrontier Desktop") which was awarded with PC Magazine Editor’s Choice 2004, PC MAGAZINE Best of Year 2004, and CNet Editor’s Choice

*	Developed "SonicWALL Enterprise Gateway Replicator" that replicates large amount of files into multiple computers across the network

*	Integrated "SonicWALL Email Security Server" into Microsoft Windows Business Server 2008. SonicWALL Email Security Server can be deployed to run alongside Microsoft Exchange 2007 with no manual configurations.

*	Developed ActiveX installer service that deploys "SonicWALL Email Security Server" through SonicWALL firewall appliances 

*	Played technical lead role in developing various anti-spam techniques using Bayesian analysis, dictionary matching, real-time block list, message hashing, language detection, image analysis, etc. 

*	Played technical lead role in developing OEM versions of "SonicWALL AntiSpam Desktop" for 3rd party security software companies (e.g. Check Point Software Technologies Limited)

*	Worked closely with customer support team to resolve critical customer escalations

*	SonicWALL was acquired by Dell in May 2012.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
*	Led the development of consumer anti-spam solution "MailFrontier Desktop" which was awarded with PC Magazine Editor’s Choice 2004, PC MAGAZINE Best of Year 2004, and CNet Editor’s Choice

*	Developed C++ library that encapsulates Microsoft "Messaging Application Programming Interface (MAPI)" into simple C++ classes. The library makes it easy for C++ developers with less/no experience in Microsoft COM (Component Object Model) technology to use Microsoft MAPI

*	Localized "MailFrontier Desktop" into English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, and Japanese

*	Played technical lead role in developing OEM versions of "MailFrontier AntiSpam Desktop" for 3rd party security software companies (e.g. Zone Labs)

*	Worked on developing anti-spam techniques using Bayesian analysis, dictionary matching, real-time block list, message hashing, language detection, etc. 

*	MailFrontier was acquired by SonicWALL on Feb 2006

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
*	Developed Transaction Identity Protector (TIP) system. TIP system authenticates users based on their previous log-in behavioral patterns in order to prevent unauthorized access using stolen identities (Java, Java Swing, Applets)

*	Developed MS Outlook and Outlook Express add-in "gagaMail" that tracks when & where messages were read (Visual Basic, Visual C++, COM, ATL, MFC, Win32 API)

*	Developed InfoScope client & server applications that deliver the geo-location intelligence to Web services in real time (Perl, GCC/G++, SUN C/C++, MySQL, Oracle) 

*	Played technical lead role in building InfoScope database that has geographical information of entire 4.3B Internet Protocol (IP) address space (Java, Visual C++, COM, ATL, ASP, JSP, XML, Perl, GCC/G++, SUN C/C++)

*	Verifia was acquired by Quova in 2007

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
*	Developed professional sport data analysis & reporting system for NFL football teams such as Dallas Cowboys, Cincinnati Bengals, etc. (Visual C++, MFC, Win32, COM, ATL, XML)

*	Developed Windows GUI for the professional digital video editing system (Visual C++, MFC, Win32 API)

*	Worked on porting legacy 16 bit Window 3.1 Borland C++ projects to 32 bit Windows 98/NT Visual C++ 6.0 projects (Visual C++, Borland C++)

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

patents.title: Image Based Spam Blocking
patents.description: A fingerprint of an image identified within a received message is generated following analysis of the message. A spam detection engine identifies an image within a message and converts the image into a grey scale image. The spam detection engine analyzes the grey scale image and assigns a score. A fingerprint of the grey scale image is generated based on the score. The fingerprint may also be based on other factors such as the message sender's status (e.g. blacklisted or whitelisted) and other scores and reports generated by the spam detection engine. The fingerprint is then used to filter future incoming messages.
